l1_words.meaning: a person's professional path over time

pattern_explanation: Turkish and English borrowed many words from French and Latin, so the forms of some words look very close in both languages. Over time, however, some meanings moved apart, so a similar form can carry a different meaning.
false_friend_warning: The Turkish word 'lisans' looks like the English word 'license', but it means a university degree. A student who translates it as 'license' will choose the wrong meaning.
